description: This file defines enumerations and function declarations related to detecting and asserting memory overlaps in tensor objects within the PyTorch library. It includes functions for checking internal overlaps, getting overlap status, and asserting no overlaps between tensors.

methods.name: has_internal_overlap
methods.description: Checks for internal memory overlap within a tensor, for both TensorBase and TensorImpl objects.

methods.name: assert_no_internal_overlap
methods.description: Asserts that there is no internal memory overlap within a tensor.

methods.name: get_overlap_status
methods.description: Retrieves the overlap status between two tensors or tensor implementations.

methods.name: assert_no_partial_overlap
methods.description: Asserts that there is no partial memory overlap between two tensors or tensor implementations.

methods.name: assert_no_overlap
methods.description: Asserts that there is no memory overlap between two tensors or tensor implementations.

calls: get_overlap_status(const TensorBase& a, const TensorBase& b)
get_overlap_status(const c10::TensorImpl* a, const c10::TensorImpl* b)
assert_no_partial_overlap(const TensorBase& a, const TensorBase& b)
assert_no_overlap(const TensorBase& a, const TensorBase& b)
